issues.problem: S4 matrix-slot credit still reaches ambiguous vendors from ordinary prose, and still ticks fabricated cells. (1) The head slot of 'Matrix entry - X:', 'Matrix - X:' and 'Row/Matrix ... "X" ...:' counts with no known feature and whatever body follows. (2) A list counts when one item is a vendor and the others are any 1-2 word leftovers, so role lists pass. (3) Leader and core-set lists need no feature. SKILL.md claims 'a known feature and every item a known vendor'.
